query:
WITH candidate AS(SELECT event_id FROM calendar_projection_outbox WHERE next_run_at<=now() AND(lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<now())
            ORDER BY next_run_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
            UPDATE calendar_projection_outbox o SET lease_id=$1,lease_until=now()+interval '2 minutes' FROM candidate c WHERE o.event_id=c.event_id
            RETURNING o.event_id,o.owner_id,o.link_id,o.change_kind,o.revision
